title: Repeating bills
emptyBody: Rent, the electricity, a subscription. Set one up and it posts itself — or reminds someone when the amount varies.
variesNote: The amount changes, so this one waits for somebody to enter it.

editor.description: It posts on its own when the amount is fixed.
editor.firstDueHint: Cannot be in the past — a new schedule should not conjure up back-dated months.
editor.variesHint: Leave the amount out and this reminds somebody instead of posting itself.
editor.splitHint: Across everyone in the group, or by their shares. Uneven splits are set per expense.

post.title: Post {title}
post.description: This creates the expense and moves the schedule on.
post.alreadyPosted: This bill has already been posted for that date.

delete.title: Delete this bill?
delete.body: The schedule stops. Expenses it has already posted are kept.
